sentences.text: Heard Mr. Siddharth Dave, learned senior counsel appearing for the petitioner (informant).

3. The counsel would read the FIR dated 29.10.2018 (Annexure P/1) to point out that it was a case of forgery and fabrication of land documents 10:23:25 IST Reason: by the accused who intended to sale plot to the petitioner.
The related land on verification was found to be non- existent at the Site.

Moreover, the Police have already filed chargesheet in the case after completion of investigation arraying the respondent Nos. 2 and 3 as accused.
4.

Adverting to the nature of the allegation and the charges, it is argued by Mr. Dave that the learned Judge could not have treated the matter to be a simple civil dispute where the offence under Sections 420 and 406 IPC are possibly not attracted.
5. Issue notice, returnable in four weeks.

(NITIN TALREJA) (DIVYA BABBAR)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
